subject: Error from parboot when assessing GOF of a model fit with gmultmix

messages.author: d640f02d29e7de63
messages.subject: Error from parboot when assessing GOF of a model fit with gmultmix
parts:
Hello,


I’m attempting to assess goodness of fit of a model that I fit with gmultmix, using parboot and the example provided on p.332 of the Kery & Royle (2015) book.


After many attempts, parboot always returns the error pasted below, although my dataset doesn't contain any missing values and parboot doesn’t seem to have a na.rm argument…


> gofPb10<-parboot(AreaBurnHarv,fitstats,nsim=10,report=1)

Error in quantile.default(newX[, i], ...) : 

  missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE


I get the error with NB and P models, and altering the number of bootstrap replicates doesn't seem to make a difference.


I’m happy to provide minimal code and data to replicate the error if it would help.


I’d really appreciate any suggestions for how to get this working!


Many thanks,


Mark B.

Ph.D. Candidate, Biology

University of Saskatchewan

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Error from parboot when assessing GOF of a model fit with gmultmix
parts:
Hi Richard,

Thanks for your help. I'm using the fitstats function suggested in ?parboot and on p333 of Kery & Royle (2015). It's pasted below, for reference.

I assume I don't have to replace "fm" (in the fitstats function, below) with the name of the model because I've specified it in the parboot statement:

> gof10_nb<-parboot(AreaBurnHarv_nb,fitstats,nsim=10,report=1) #p333 Kery & Royle (2015)

So, the fitstats function doesn't explicitly handle NAs and I'm not sure how to modify it to do so. But...my siteCovs don't have any NAs. However, there are lots of NAs in my y data (i.e., sites that were missed on a particular occasion).

Thanks,

Mark


fitstats <- function(fm) { #function returning three fit-statistics, from ?parboot
  observed <- getY(fm@data)
  expected <- fitted(fm)
  resids <- residuals(fm)
  sse <- sum(resids^2)
  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)
  freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)
  out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
  return(out)

}

messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Error from parboot when assessing GOF of a model fit with gmultmix
parts:
Dear Mark,

as Richard said, the following should work in your case:

fitstats <- function(fm) { #function returning three fit-statistics, from ?parboot
  observed <- getY(fm@data)
  expected <- fitted(fm)
  resids <- residuals(fm)

sse <- sum(resids^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected, na.rm = TRUE)
  freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
  return(out)

}

Best regards  --  Marc

PS: Please note that the official publication date of AHM1 is 2016, not 2015
